description: Prior Approval (Part 20 Class A) for the erection of a single storey upward extension totalling 3.35 metres in height (raising the height of the existing building to 14.4m) to the main (original) footprint of the property to provide 5 new residential units and associated alterations.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>No above-ground works shall commence until details of all external materials, including cladding, roof finish, windows, balustrades and doors, have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority</p><p>To ensure that the external appearance of the development is of a high quality, responds appropriately to the character of the existing building and surrounding area, and preserves the visual amenity of the locality, in accordance with Policy LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021).</p>

<p>Prior to occupation, details of sound insulation between the new residential units and existing premises shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA, and the approved details implemented before occupation.</p><p>In the interest of protecting the amenity of future and existing occupiers through the control of noise transmission between uses, in accordance with Policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP56 (Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and Policy D14 of the London Plan (2021).</p>

<p>Prior to occupation, cycle storage facilities as shown on the approved plans shall be provided and retained for the lifetime of the development</p><p>To promote sustainable modes of transport, reduce reliance on private motor vehicles, and ensure appropriate provision of cycle storage for occupiers, in accordance with Policy LP48 (Transport and Sustainable Travel) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and Policy T5 of the London Plan (2021).</p>

<p>Refuse and recycling storage facilities as shown on the approved drawings shall be provided prior to occupation and retained thereafter</p><p>To ensure adequate provision for the storage and collection of refuse and recycling, to protect the amenities of occupiers and the surrounding area, and to promote sustainable waste management, in accordance with Policy LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP58 (Improving the Environment) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).</p>

<p>No development shall commence until a Construction Logistics Management Plan has been submitted to and approved by the LPA.</p><p>To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the safety and operation of the surrounding highway network, or unduly impact the amenity of nearby occupiers during construction, in accordance with Policies LP2 (Development and Amenity) and LP48 (Transport and Sustainable Travel) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020).</p><p><br></p>
